page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Manage your account and household preferences

household.title: Household
household.description: These settings are used as defaults when planning recipes and shopping lists.
household.size_hint: Used as the default serving count when adding recipes to a shopping list.
household.frequency_hint: Determines the default date range when creating a new shopping list.
household.budget_hint: Spending cap for one shopping period. Leave empty for no budget.
household.currency_hint: Used to display recipe and shopping list costs.
household.store_hint: Costs are shown at this retailer's prices. Shop wherever you like.

delete_account.title: Delete Account
delete_account.description: Permanently delete your account and all associated data.
delete_account.dialog_description: All your account data will be permanently deleted. If you are sure, please click "Confirm" to proceed. This action cannot be undone.
delete_account.success: Your account has been successfully deleted

household_sharing.title: Household sharing
household_sharing.description: Share your shopping lists and meal plans with the people you cook for.
household_sharing.none_title: You are not sharing with anyone
household_sharing.none_description: Create a household to share lists and plans. Everyone in it sees and edits the same lists.
household_sharing.leave_confirm: Leave this household? You will stop seeing its shared lists and plans.
household_sharing.disband_confirm: Delete this household? Sharing ends for everyone. Nobody's own recipes, lists or plans are deleted.
